report:
Feature: First setup asks for the first train and shows the switch hint
Expected: A dialog asks the user to place the first train ('Bahn 1') on the calibration point and offers a button to confirm this, and the page shows a hint that the user should check whether the switches are set correctly
Observed failure: Opened the app and read the snapshot without clicking. The dialog 'Ersteinrichtung' with a confirm button and the switch hint appears, but it asks for the second train ('Bitte Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.', button 'Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'); the track already shows 'Zug Bahn 1'. A reload showed the same; the page never asks for Bahn 1.
Steps completed before failure: 1

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app; the dialog said 'Bitte Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.' and 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' was clicked. After waiting 25 seconds the new snapshot still showed only 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and the switch hint; it did not ask for Bahn 2. The track plan showed 'Zug Bahn 1'.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' in the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog; calibration started (Bahn 1 showed 25 cm/s · rückwärts, a 'Zug Bahn 1' marker appeared). After the 25-second wait the new snapshot still showed the dialog with 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and the switch hint; it never asked to place Bahn 2.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt'; calibration started (Bahn 1 on the track plan, speed '25 cm/s · rückwärts'). After the 25-second wait the snapshot still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and the switch note, no request for Bahn 2; the protocol still said 'Noch keine Ereignisse.' (click, wait and snapshot were sent in one message).
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' the panel showed 'Noch keine Haltestelle gewählt.'; clicking Start was refused (badge stayed 'Gestoppt', Start button still shown, speed 0 cm/s), but the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' did not appear in the accessibility tree, nor any equivalent message; a second Start click with an immediate snapshot also showed no message.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: Opened the app; the 'Ersteinrichtung' dialog showed 'Bitte Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen.'; clicked 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt', waited 25 seconds and took a new snapshot. The dialog still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' instead of asking for Bahn 2; Bahn 1 showed '25 cm/s · rückwärts' and the log showed 'Noch keine Ereignisse.' (Tester note: click, wait and snapshot were sent in one message instead of sequentially.)
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2': the trains passed each other and both keep reaching their stops
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt'; clicked Stop. Stop lists were already correct. Clicked Start ('Start' at 03:19:15), waited 4 x 30 s. The only entries newer than 'Start' were 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2' (03:19:20) and 'Bahn 1 wartet' (03:19:25); nothing was logged for ~2 minutes afterwards although the badge showed 'In Fahrt' and Bahn 2 showed 0 cm/s. No 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', no 'fährt weiter', no 'Bahn 2 erreicht …': the trains stopped and never passed each other (deadlock).
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed) and the direction forward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: Both histories contain '120 forward' and only 60/120/0 are used (met). But 'Speed (0-255)' was 0 for both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 when the console was read ~15 s after Start; the message log shows both trains were sent speed 0 within ~50 ms of each other right before the reading, so no train was moving at that moment.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed) and the direction forward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: After Start and 15 s wait, the mock console showed 'Speed (0-255)' 0 for both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2; the message log shows the app sent speed 0 to both trains at 06:45:24.268 and 06:45:24.318. Both histories contain '120 forward' and only 60/120 are used (met). The condition that at least one train currently drives was not met.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2' (other entries in between are allowed): after its last stop the train starts again with its first stop
Observed failure: After Start (08:44:36) and 5 x 30 s, the log since that Start contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2' (08:46:05) and 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' (08:46:19), but not the second 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2'; the newest entries were 'Bahn 2 erreicht Haltestelle 4' (08:47:20) and 'Bahn 1 wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' (08:47:14). Bahn 1 only reached its first stop 89 s after Start because both trains waited at the beginning.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; it is sufficient that each train is seen moving in its own sense in at least one pair of consecutive screenshots; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: Five screenshots 10 s to 30 s after Start. Bahn 2 moved counter-clockwise (left curve down, bottom straight, right curve up, top straight right to left). Bahn 1 was never seen on the main loop: in every screenshot it was on the siding (near the Kalibrierpunkt, then moving left past Weiche 2 towards Weiche 1), so its clockwise sense could not be verified.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Bahn 1 seen moving clockwise and Bahn 2 counter-clockwise along the main loop
Observed failure: In all five screenshots (10 s to 30 s after Start) Bahn 1 moved clockwise, but Bahn 2 did not move at all: it stood on the siding at Weiche 2 for the whole run. The log after Start (11:18:01) contains only Bahn 1 events; the previous run (Start 11:16:49) showed the same. Bahn 2 was never seen moving counter-clockwise.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen'
Observed failure: Before Start the 'Weichen' history had 28 applied entries; after Start and 2 x 30 s it still had exactly 28. Only Bahn 1 drove (speed 120); Bahn 2 stayed at speed 0 with an unchanged history.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: '<train> weicht aus' and later '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' since the last Start
Observed failure: After Start (11:24:20) and 3 x 30 s the log had only 7 entries, all 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2/4'. Bahn 2 logged nothing, never met Bahn 1 and never evaded; no 'weicht aus' or 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' entry.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter', then '… erreicht …' for both trains
Observed failure: After Start (11:26:55) and 4 x 30 s the log had 10 entries, all 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2/4'. No waiting/continuing entry and no entry for Bahn 2; Bahn 2 never reached a stop.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: The markers never overlap; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: The markers never overlapped in the three screenshots, but Bahn 2 never moved: it stayed on the siding at Weiche 2 (0 cm/s) and the log only showed Bahn 1 reaching stops. The separation was only because Bahn 2 stayed parked; no waiting/evading while the other passes was observed.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' since the last Start, with the calibration speed in the mock history
Observed failure: After Start (11:35:14) and about 2 min 13 s the log only showed 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2/4'; no 'wird kalibriert' / 'ist kalibriert' entry for either train and no entry for Bahn 2 at all (its last activity before 11:16:26).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt' and waiting 25 seconds, the dialog still showed 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …' and Bahn 1 was still moving at 25 cm/s backward; the dialog never asked for Bahn 2. (The tester sent the click, the wait and the snapshot together in one message.)
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter', then '… erreicht …' for both trains
Observed failure: After Start (14:20:08): Bahn 1 reached H2, waited, recalibrated (14:20:28-31), Bahn 2 reached H4 (14:20:35), then 'Bahn 1 wartet' and 'Bahn 2 wartet' (14:20:40). No further entries for about 100 seconds: both trains were left waiting for each other (deadlock).
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: The markers never overlap; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: The markers never overlapped, but in all three screenshots Bahn 2 stood at Weiche 1 and Bahn 1 on the lower track left of Weiche 2; neither moved (0 cm/s), the only log entry after Start was 'Bahn 2 wartet'. One train waited but the other never passed; the system looks deadlocked.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: '<train> wird kalibriert' followed by '<train> ist kalibriert' since the last Start, with the calibration speed in the mock history
Observed failure: After Start (14:28:58) and 4 x 30 s the only log entry was 'Bahn 2 wartet'; both locomotives stayed at speed 0, no calibration happened.
Steps completed before failure: 11
